source: manifests/authored.db: class defaults (effective = authored + parents) + compiled particle stream

summary.note: LifeSpan (10 s) and Lifetime (60 s) are both authored on the dropped pickup; which one ends the drop (HmDroppedPickup / TnDroppedPickup native or script) is RE's to confirm - PROVISIONAL

particle_system.provenance: tagged props (ParticleSystem / Emitter / LOD / RequiredModule / TypeData): CONFIRMED AUTHORED DATA; compiled modules: ModuleId from the cooked EParticleModuleId enum + distributions assigned by pstream.assign (module order; per-class property order) - CONFIRMED where "complete" is true

distribution_layout.uniform (types 3/9): values = two endpoints A then B (1 or 3 floats each); per-particle value = lerp(A, B, random). Endpoint order is as stored; uniform sampling makes it irrelevant
distribution_layout.constant curve (types 2/8): values[0:2] = output range min/max, values[2] = start time, values[3] = time scale (samples per unit time); then N samples of 1 (float) or 3 (vector) floats, sample i at t = start + i / time_scale, linear between samples (UE3 FRawDistribution baking)
distribution_layout.uniform curve (types 4/10): same header; each sample holds two endpoints (2 or 6 floats)
distribution_layout.Lifetime 0: UE3: particle lives until killed by the emitter (no expiry)
distribution_layout.provenance: header/sample layout from the Systems lodscan notes, consistent with every decoded table (sample count = time_scale + 1 for 0..1 curves)

mesh: none: neither class authors a StaticMesh / SkeletalMesh component; the drop is drawn by its particle system
